title: Reasonableness of a sparse Bernoulli variable
statement: For every natural number $n$, let a Boolean random variable equal true with probability $2^{-n}$ and false otherwise, and let its real-valued indicator be $1$ on true and $0$ on false. This variable is reasonable with parameter $2^n$: this parameter is at least $1$, and its fourth moment is at most $2^n$ times the square of its second moment.
